correctness.rationale: A full proof handles all odd primes p, every k at least K_p, and all unit shifts. Each residue branch is an analytic graph of p^k points. Every pair of branches has one intersection because the Teichmüller linear system has unit determinant. A hypothetical common triple gives three complex points on two distinct circles, forcing a nonzero cyclotomic integer with norm at most 8^phi(p-1). The congruence would force its norm divisible by p^(k+1), impossible above the bound. The scaled quotient-coordinate valuation and the modular shift bijection are included. Independently executed verify.py checked ten whole-period instances and three shifts. Finite checks are corroborative, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The joint value set of consecutive Fermat quotients is a motivated invariant from earlier joint-distribution research. The theorem gives its exact stable image size and entire 1/2-multiplicity profile for every odd prime and every coprime shift, replacing approximate information with a structural branch-intersection classification and an explicit effective stabilization threshold. The small-exponent triple collision at p=11 makes the eventual phenomenon a genuine, nontrivial boundary rather than an obvious fixed-level identity.
